normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only feeds the transfer entry point and has no independent state.
Amount parameter only feeds the transfer entry point before being forwarded to transferFrom.
Source parameter is consumed directly by transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
Destination parameter is consumed directly by transferFrom balance updates.
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used to key the allowance mapping write.
Amount parameter is only stored into the allowance mapping.
Target address parameter is only used as the delegatecall destination inside delegate.
Calldata parameter is only forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate.
Recipient array parameter is consumed by the batchSend distribution loop.
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
Source parameter is only used for the modifier privilege comparison.
Destination parameter is only used for the modifier privilege comparison.
Local total holds the result of the unchecked multiplication and has no independent state.
Loop counter only controls iteration of the batchSend loop.
Loop-local recipient is a transient copy used only during batchSend iteration.
Local UNI pair address is computed solely for the modifier privilege check.
